# State of Vice

> Independent GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) answers and guides site. Every claim is labeled either CONFIRMED (sourced to Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or official material) or RUMOR (leaks and reports, clearly flagged as unverified). No clickbait, no fake leaks presented as fact.

Key facts we maintain (current as of October 20, 2026):
- GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (confirmed by Rockstar Games; reaffirmed by Take-Two in August 2026)
- Digital pre-loads open November 12, 2026
- Price: $79.99 Standard Edition, $99.99 Ultimate Edition (confirmed June 25, 2026)
- No PC version at launch; a GamesBeat report (Oct 13, 2026) says PC is planned for Q1 2027 — not confirmed by Rockstar
- ESRB rating: M for Mature 17+
- Official launch trailer released October 15, 2026; 26-minute "An Extended Look" gameplay presentation released August 27, 2026
- Setting: Vice City and the state of Leonida (regions: Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Grassrivers, Mount Kalaga National Park)
- Dual protagonists: Jason and Lucia (switchable at any time); voice actors not officially announced
- No online mode announced for launch
